content: Self-pairing on the cyclobutanecarboxamide variant, whose numbering I confirmed earlier: atom 14 is the cyclobutane CH bonded to the carbonyl at atom 12 over a non-ring bond, so anchoring there preserves the four-membered cap. This episode stacks the three settings that each measured best on their own axis but have never been combined. The meta anilide is the big one at 0.50 against 0.41 for para. The C4 substituent is activity-insensitive across methyl, chloro, methoxy, cyclopropyl and cyclobutyl, so I should choose it purely on drug-likeness - and chloro gave the best QED of that set at 0.898. The cap is likewise activity-flat, and cyclobutyl gave the best QED among the carbocycles at 0.894 while keeping SA better than the oxetane. So: meta geometry for activity, 4-chloro and cyclobutyl for QED, both donors free, plain benzene centre, nothing on pyridine C3, C5 or C6. Expected product: N-{3-[(4-chloropyridin-2-yl)amino]phenyl}cyclobutanecarboxamide at about 302 Da.
